notes: §2002:12.2.6.2 SR23 literal-8 excludes the digits, the letters A B C D E N P R S V X Z or their lowercase equivalents, the space and the special characters. kb/Work PB5647: CurrencySymbolEquivalence.Fold folds a character outside the repertoire to its invariant upper case only from 2014 (the implementor's additional-character specification, §2014:8.1.1), so at 2002 U+017F is no lowercase equivalent of S (case equivalence is between basic letters, §2002:8.1.2.1 GR3) and is a legal PICTURE SYMBOL; the key, the PICTURE fold and the exclusion test share the one function.
